items.title: Tech stocks drag Nasdaq lower on report of OpenAI revenue fall, high yields
items.summary: US equity indexes fell, influenced by megacap technology stocks and concerns regarding OpenAI's revenue performance. The Nasdaq 100 and S&P 500 saw declines as the yield on the 10-year Treasury rose. Additionally, increased oil prices and energy supply fears contributed to market pressure. Federal Reserve comments indicated potential for further interest rate increases, impacting credit sectors. A rise in economic-policy uncertainty reflects growing concerns among investors amid upcoming election dynamics.

items.title: GST reforms: Refunds, wider ITC mark third phase of reform as India targets global supply chains, says PwC’s Pratik Jain
items.summary: PwC’s Pratik Jain said the GST Council’s latest measures mark the third phase of the tax reform, shifting focus to bolder policy changes and ease of doing business. He said wider refunds for input services and capital goods, along with ITC on employee insurance, could ease working-capital stress and lower costs.

items.title: GST 2026: Simpler compliance, tech-led enforcement reflect growing trust between government and industry, says Deloitte’s MS Mani
items.summary: Deloitte India’s MS Mani said the latest GST reforms reflect growing trust between government and industry, with technology enabling simpler compliance and more targeted enforcement. He said easier registration, annual returns with quarterly payments, return corrections and removal of arrest provisions could reduce compliance fears and bring more businesses onto the GST platform.

items.title: GST rejig: Credit relief, export push and simpler rules make Diwali come early for industry, says EY’s Bipin Sapra
items.summary: EY partner Bipin Sapra said the GST Council’s latest reforms address input tax credit blockages, expand refunds, support exporters and streamline tax administration. He said rationalising Section 17(5) could reduce tax cascading and costs for businesses, while decriminalisation and removal of arrest powers should create a more conducive business environment.

items.title: ET Graphics: The GST playbook — milestones over 9 years
items.summary: From its rollout in 2017 to GST 2.0, India’s goods and services tax has evolved into a more digitised and predictable tax regime. Over nine years, the system has seen changes in tax rates, slabs, compliance and technology, reshaping how businesses manage indirect taxes and interact with the tax administration.

items.title: GST reforms: 16 lakh small businesses may get annual return option, easier e-commerce selling
items.summary: More than 16 lakh small businesses with turnover up to Rs 5 crore could benefit from a simplified GST compliance regime, under which they would pay tax quarterly but file one return annually. The overhaul also rationalises penalties, waives late fees and simplifies registration for eligible small e-commerce sellers.

items.title: ‘Is Ambani the real boss of India’, asks Elon Musk as Centre refutes bias in Starlink authorisation
items.summary: Reliance Jio chairman Akash Ambani declines to comment when asked about Mr. Musk’s remarks; Rahul Gandhi joins the debate saying, “Wait till you discover the other guy”

items.title: GST reforms: No tax on toll collection by highway concessionaires; road maintenance tax liability clarified
items.summary: The GST Council has clarified that highway concessionaires collecting exempt tolls will face no GST liability on the toll collection right, regardless of whether concession payments are made upfront or over time. It also said GST on road maintenance services will arise when funds are actually drawn against expenditure, not merely parked in escrow.

items.title: GST reforms: 38,700 exporters to get faster refunds, wider access to input tax credits
items.summary: Nearly 38,700 export taxpayers will become eligible for cash refunds on input taxes paid on services and plant and machinery under GST reforms. The Council also approved automatic release of 90% of refund claims after risk checks, faster acknowledgements and wider export benefits for service providers and manufacturers.

items.title: Thermax scouts for a partner to charge up its green energy unit
items.summary: Thermax has set its sights on attracting external investors to its renewable energy subsidiary, First Energy. By contemplating a major stake sale, the company aims to overcome operational challenges and elevate its performance levels. First Energy, with its 800 MW capacity, is looking to enhance service delivery, reflecting a growing inclination in the renewable energy domain for partnerships that facilitate expansion and development.

items.title: GST overhaul: Export status for contract manufacturing to boost supply-chain shifts to India
items.summary: GST reforms treating contract manufacturing for foreign principals as exports could boost India’s appeal as companies relocate parts of their supply chains. Expanded refunds covering input services and capital goods, faster 90% refunds and measures to release blocked tax credits are also expected to unlock working capital and support investment.

items.title: FSSAI pulls up Dr Reddy's, Nestle Health Science over Celevida claims
items.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) said the product was advertised as providing high-protein support for preserving lean muscle during GLP-1/GIP therapies, commonly used in weight-loss treatment.

items.title: GST reforms 2026: Employers get ITC on employee health, life insurance premiums
items.summary: The GST Council has recommended allowing employers to claim input tax credit on GST paid for health and life insurance policies taken for employees. The move could reduce the effective cost of employer-sponsored coverage, particularly benefiting small businesses, while making group health insurance more affordable and improving employee benefits.

items.title: Surging bond yields likely to slash banks' treasury income
items.summary: Banks are expected to report a nearly 60% decline in treasury income for the July-September quarter. Analysts predict treasury gains to decrease from ₹13,100 crore last year to ₹5,500 crore this year. Rising government bond yields have negatively impacted investment portfolios, leading to lower gains. Public sector banks will feel a more pronounced effect due to their larger government securities portfolios.

items.title: Elon Musk steps up Starlink push, asks why India has not given licence; government says all three satcom firms are at same stage
items.summary: Elon Musk is pushing for Starlink's approval in India while alleging that oligarchs are blocking its entry. He emphasizes that Starlink has complied with all regulations for five years without receiving a license. The government has stated that all involved parties are at the same regulatory stage awaiting security approvals. The ministry insists that compliance with security conditions is mandatory before moving forward.

items.title: Google, Amazon, Meta, Apple fuel India's renewable energy boom as data centre demand surges
items.summary: Major technology companies like Google, Amazon, Meta, and Apple are increasingly purchasing renewable energy in India. Their expanding data centers are significantly driving the demand for clean electricity. Research predicts that renewable capacity for data centers could grow to 32.4 GW by 2030. These companies are pursuing long-term power purchase agreements to secure renewable energy directly from developers.

items.title: I-T dept moves appellate tribunal against Rs 32.66-cr tax relief to Dr Lal PathLabs
items.summary: Dr Lal PathLabs, in a regulatory filing, said that it received an intimation on Wednesday regarding an appeal filed by the I-T Department before the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT), New Delhi.

items.title: GST reforms 2026: Govt plans faceless, centralised CGST system for 2 lakh multi-jurisdiction taxpayers
items.summary: GST reforms 2026 will move around 2 lakh businesses operating across multiple CGST jurisdictions towards a centralised, faceless tax administration, Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said. The framework will cover scrutiny, audits, adjudication, appeals and taxpayer services, with public consultation planned before Budget 2027 and implementation targeted for FY28.

items.title: OpenAI’s Revenue Run Rate Nears $50 Billion, Less Than Reported
items.summary: OpenAI is on track to generate annualized revenue of roughly $50 billion based on its current performance, according to people familiar with the matter, an uptick from the prior year but less than some recently reported estimates for the ChatGPT maker.

items.title: SC backs disposal of Goa iron ore dumps without fresh auction
items.summary: The Supreme Court has made a significant ruling in favor of the Goa government's approach to managing iron ore dumps. This decision allows former mining leaseholders to clear their inventory mine dumps without conducting a public auction. The court stressed the critical need for environmental protection in this context, cautioning against dire outcomes.

items.title: RBI’s sell-buy swaps slow rupee’s fall but push up forward premiums, making hedging costlier for foreign investors
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is engaged in dollar sell-buy swaps to stabilize the rupee's value. However, this has resulted in higher forward premiums, making it expensive for foreign investors to hedge. As a consequence, some foreign investments in rupee-denominated assets may decline. Additionally, companies are opting to borrow in rupees and exchange for dollars due to favorable local rates.

items.title: Dr Reddy’s Laboratories receives two observations for Andhra Pradesh facility
items.summary: The US health regulator completed a Pre-Approval Inspection (PAI) at the company's FTO-11 manufacturing unit from October 5-7, Dr Reddy's Laboratories said in a regulatory filing on Thursday.

items.title: Festive rush: Airlines hike fuel surcharge as ATF prices soar
items.summary: Airlines like Air India and Akasa Air have announced increased fuel surcharges for both domestic and international flights. The rise in aviation turbine fuel prices has significantly impacted operational costs for carriers. Domestic surcharges will be effective on new bookings from October 9, as the festive season approaches. International surcharges vary depending on destination, reflecting additional costs incurred by airlines.

items.title: Treasuries Rise as Lofty Yields Lure Demand to 30-Year Sale
items.summary: US Treasuries rose after an auction of 30-year debt drew solid demand as long-dated yields edge away from their highest levels in more than two decades.

items.title: Airlines suspend, cut Riyadh flights amid security concerns
items.summary: Airlines such as Air India Express and IndiGo are cancelling flights to and from Riyadh due to security issues. Several airlines have cited evolving conditions affecting civilian air travel in the region. Passengers affected by these cancellations are being offered options for refunds or rescheduling. India's Ministry of External Affairs condemned attacks on airports, affirming the unacceptable targeting of civilian infrastructure.

items.title: Black Sea attacks hit yellow peas, sunflower oil supplies to India
items.summary: Russia's exports of yellow peas and sunflower oil to India have been disrupted by ongoing conflicts. As a result, prices for yellow peas have risen from ₹40 to ₹46 per kg in the last two months. Importers report that shipments from Russia have not occurred recently, affecting the availability of yellow peas. Meanwhile, sunflower oil shipments are also hindered, causing expectations of higher prices in the near future.

items.title: Form panel to curb pharma freebies: SC
items.summary: The Supreme Court has ordered the government to establish a committee to investigate unethical pharmaceutical marketing. The committee is to evaluate current regulatory frameworks and enforcement mechanisms. It must also consult stakeholders and submit recommendations within two months of its first meeting. After reviewing the committee's report, the government will prepare a compliance affidavit. The court is set to consider this affidavit in a hearing scheduled for January 29.

items.title: Infosys, TCS, Wipro, Microsoft suspended from US Green Card programme: Explained in 10 points
items.summary: PERM certification serves as a crucial step for most employment-based Green Cards. Indian IT companies and even multinational IT firms with significant operations in India rely heavily on US employment-based Green Card processing.

items.title: Experiments on animals set to become easier
items.summary: The Centre plans to significantly change the regulations governing animal experimentation. The proposed rules aim to allow institutional ethics panels to approve most experiments. Currently, only small animal experiments can be approved at the institutional level while larger ones require central oversight.

items.title: US 30-year fixed-rate mortgage rate hits 7.40%, likely to further erode housing demand
items.summary: In the U.S., the 30-year fixed-rate mortgage has surged to 7.40%, fueled by rising inflation that has also driven up energy costs and Treasury yields. With midterm elections looming, the housing market is grappling with affordability challenges. Homeowners are reluctant to sell due to these higher mortgage rates. While home prices remain high, experts forewarn of a potential market stall rather than a significant downturn.

items.title: GST Council Meeting Oct 2026: List of decisions taken - Arrest, prosecution, general penalty and more
items.summary: GST Council Meeting October 2026: Key decisions include ending arrest powers for GST officers, raising the prosecution threshold to  ₹5 crore, reducing penalties, faster refunds and simpler registration processes.

items.title: US President Donald Trump buys $1 million-plus stakes in Meta, Microsoft, McDonald’s; adds SpaceX debt
items.summary: Donald Trump invested over $1 million in stocks of several major companies during August. Notable purchases included Meta Platforms, McDonald's, Microsoft, and space-related debt from SpaceX. His investment activities encompass trading in shares of Nvidia and Advanced Micro Devices, key players in the AI sector. Trump's financial dealings during his presidency have raised concerns about potential conflicts of interest.

items.title: India, Singapore eye 2,000 MW power corridor
items.summary: India and Singapore are considering plans for a 2,000 MW cross-border power interconnection that could enhance energy security. The proposed land-based transmission corridor would connect Imphal in India to Singapore via Myanmar, Thailand, and Malaysia.

items.title: Exports to hit $1 trillion this fiscal: Piyush Goyal
items.summary: Goyal said that the nine free trade agreements finalised by India in recent years provide huge business opportunities for exporters. He urged industry chamber CII to set up FTA utilisation cells in states.

items.title: Sugar stock checks to intensify after GST discrepancies
items.summary: Beginning October 9, the government will implement a rigorous verification process of sugar stocks due to discrepancies discovered in both sales and GST data from sugar mills. With festival season approaching, the demand for sugar is increasing, putting pressure on mills to meet their sales quotas. Any mills failing to comply with these requirements may face legal actions for record discrepancies.

items.title: TCS posts slowest Q2 growth in three years as demand stays muted
items.summary: TCS reported 0.2% sequential revenue growth in July–September quarter, beating analyst expectations but marking its slowest second-quarter growth in three years.

items.title: India, 14 others ink joint ministerial statement to curb structural excess capacity
items.summary: India has joined the US, EU, UK and 12 other economies in a joint statement to tackle structural excess capacity and production, despite facing a US trade probe over alleged overcapacity. The signatories will examine key sectors including EVs, batteries, chemicals, semiconductors and solar panels through dedicated sectoral platforms.

Executives said AI, on-device processing, computing, cybersecurity and domestic intellectual property will shape the next phase of India’s digital infrastructure and global technology ambitions.

At India Mobile Congress 2026, executives said the sector’s next phase must focus on secure connectivity, AI, trust and global technology leadership.

items.title: Great Indian Festival to ‘break previous records’ as early deals see 35-40% growth: Amazon India executive | Exclusive
items.summary: Amazon India expects its Great Indian Festival 2026 to set new records, after early deals grew 35–40%. The company expanded Amazon Now to 120 cities, increased fulfilment capacity by nearly 50%, added logistics facilities and created 160,000 seasonal jobs, its top executive in India said.

items.title: India sugar production view slashed as El Nino hits, USDA says
items.summary: The USDA has slashed its expectations for Indian sugar production in the 2026/27 season to 29.5 million metric tons due to a forecasted rainfall shortfall. This predicted deficit is set to impact sugarcane's sucrose level and decrease the area available for effective harvesting. Moreover, looming drought conditions are likely to disrupt milling operations by early 2027.

The move targets the excessive mark-ups currently averaging 170% for various non-scheduled anti-cancer medicines, potentially saving around Rs 2,500 crore and enhancing affordability for patients.

The FSSAI pointed out potentially misleading information related to muscle strength, immunity boosting, and energy metabolism. This can mislead consumers about true health benefits. The implicated companies are mandated to justify their claims and may encounter future sanctions.

items.summary: Jio Platforms MD Akash Ambani said the company will continue to focus on affordability while delivering quality services, even as rivals raise tariffs. items.summary: Indian markets plunged on Thursday as RBI policy tightening, persistent FII selling, rising bond yields and rupee weakness battered sentiment. The Nifty hit a 52-week low of 22,179, while the Sensex fell 1,045 points, wiping out over Rs 10 lakh crore.

items.title: Manipur CM seeks highway, elevated road projects in meeting with Nitin Gadkari
items.summary: Manipur Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh urged Union minister Nitin Gadkari to expedite key road projects, including construction of the Shangshak-Tengnoupal Highway and sanction of an elevated highway in Imphal. He also sought completion of ongoing works on National Highways 37 and 2 this working season to improve connectivity.

Research based on World Bank data has predicted that the proportion of jobs threatened in India by automation is 69 percent, in China it is 77 percent and in Ethiopia, the percentage of jobs threatened by automation is 85 percent," he said.
